- Description: Kirsten Ritschel's cash sale of 3 chocolate bars to Elizabeth Wong (Liz), plus fixing a QR-code validation bug hit along the way.
  
  What happened:
  - Elizabeth Wong bought 3 chocolate bars from Kirsten Ritschel for cash; Kirsten Venmo'd Gary $30 (8/25/26).
  - Submitted 3 [SALES EVENT]s (QR codes 2024_20260710_24/22/11, $10/bar, sold by + cash collected by Kirsten Ritschel, owner Elizabeth Wong).
  - report_sales.py's CLI rejected all 3 QR codes: its qr_code_format validator used a regex requiring a farm-token segment (e.g. 2024OSCAR_...) that these legitimate legacy-format codes never had. Verified against the live "Agroverse QR codes" sheet tab that the codes were correct, not a data error.
  - Diagnosed and rewrote dao_client/truesight_dao_client/validators.py's qr_code_format to check against the real source of truth (lineage-assets/qrs_index.json on GitHub, generated from the same sheet) instead of a regex, mirroring the existing fetch_treasury_cache()/ledger_name() pattern in the same file; kept the old regex only as a fallback if the cache is unreachable. Verified: all 3 real codes now pass, a fake code is rejected, and the fallback path still works offline.
  - Handed the fix (full diagnosis + working diff) to Sophia via Telegram to apply/commit/PR (not yet merged as of this submission - PR evidence to follow separately once it lands).
  - Traced the $30 Venmo cash proceeds through the treasury cache (per-person USD custody tracking) and submitted an [INVENTORY MOVEMENT] (Kirsten Ritschel -> Gary Teh, USD, 30) so the cash handoff is captured on the ledger, not just the sale.
  
  Why: keeps the Main Ledger accurate for a real cash sale, and fixes a CLI validator bug that would otherwise keep blocking legitimate legacy-format QR codes for any future cash sale.
- Contributor(s): Envoy TrueSight, Gary Teh
